title: can't end subscription and if you can THEY STILL STEAL YOUR MONEY! Full on scam! Don't use it!
body:
It's too childish and like a game for me. Also, I just LOVE how the app "magically" stops working the second I try to log into my account to manage subscriptions (to END my trial). Also it's not worth the price of ~37 euris BIweekly! Insane

Edit: I got my subscription cancelled and the STILL tried to charge me a few days later! Total scam. AND THE SAME EVENING THEY STILL CHARGED THE MONEY! TOTAL SCAM APP! DO NOT GET IT!
author: Raja Teele

title: Crashing every minute
body: If your mental health is in decline it’s better you started meditating, working out and sleeping better. This app crashes so much that it will give you an extra mental breakdown

title: Bad experience
body: I was charged way more than I had accepted. Support team did not help. After promises that no further charges would be applied I still got monthly checks. I am extremely sad and the app has made me feel used and scared for it’s actions.

title: Be careful with your credit card

title: Terrible app that steals your money and no customer support!
body: I cancelled my subscription exactly one year ago but still another year’s subscription has been deducted from my card!!! Is this for real?? Stop scamming people out of money. I even thought to give the app another try after seeing the money was charged, but during setup I’m again offered 7-day free trial with a promise for another subscription payment after the free period. So Fabulous is trying to scam double amount for a year’s subscription! What the hell is wrong with your company????!
author: der Spunk

title: Beautiful but too much
body: It is an astonishing app with beautiful design, made for someone who really want to feel fabulous and to keep herself busy while using it. For me it was too much - too much clicking and with every click the visual changed a lot (together with audio effects). It was hard to keep focus or to understand what just happened or what happens next (long explanations didn’t help because I didn’t care to read them, it’s not a blog article).

title: Fabulously awful!
body: Fabulous graphics. Fascinating Introduction. Paid the price in expectation that the paid content makes more sense or will gradually guide me to a smooth experience but so far very disappointing! Just a huge maze of different menus and options I simply don’t understand. Really can’t comprehend what I’m supposed to click or tweak. Just a huge mess of gazillion great ideas what to include in one app. The result is awful. I can’t even begin to describe how to improve. I suggest to start from scratch with a team with previous experience in creating apps. Pity!
